name: Planlens
chosen: Paid Cursor/VS Code extension that reviews Terraform and OpenTofu plan JSON in the editor.
why: HashiCorp's official extension (6.6M installs) can run terraform plan but does not review the plan. Existing visualizers have 500–10k installs and require a manual JSON export. Companies already pay for Terraform Cloud, Spacelift, and Infracost, so willingness to pay for IaC review is real. The work is deterministic JSON parsing, not an AI wrapper. Dual-list on VS Code Marketplace and OpenVSX (Cursor).
rejected: gRPC/API clients — crowded free tools (API Studio, Daakia, Thunder Client)
Prisma/Drizzle — official free Prisma extension; Drizzle is TypeScript-native
OpenAPI breaking changes — oasdiff already owns CLI/CI; wrapping it is a commodity
Lockfile merge — solved by git merge drivers, weak willingness to pay
AI wrappers, trading, freelance, content farms — killed by constraints
free: Open terraform show -json / OpenTofu plan JSON
Sensitive value redaction for plan-marked before_sensitive/after_sensitive (unmarked secrets can still appear)
Review of an opened plan JSON file does not contact Planlens infrastructure; plan JSON is not uploaded
pro: Run terraform or tofu plan from the editor and open the review
kill_if: 90 days after listing, fewer than 5 paid sales and no organic marketplace search traction. Do not buy ads. Do not spend the $500 on acquisition.
deferred_tests: Run Plan against a real terraform/tofu binary in a trusted throwaway folder
Polar license validation with a real granted key
